summary: Redesigned data processing rules as a plain-language When/Then editor with dataset-aware values and a standard resizable rules table.
details: Row filter and Action merge into one Then condition list; the saved rule JSON format is unchanged.
'is' / 'is any of' collapse into a single tokenized condition value input with suggestions narrowed to combinations observed for the selected dataset type.
Source-value chips warn without blocking when values are absent or cannot occur with the other current conditions.
Rules are listed in the standard Project Settings table with enabled switches and resizable Name, Dataset type, Applies when, and Effect columns.
Keep-only rules with extra row filters now state that unfiltered rows pass through untouched.
The rule name is a labeled body field instead of a title-bar control, and the editor reflows narrow layouts while keeping its header and actions clear of scrolling content.
Field selectors and rule summaries preserve exact Field Mapping names such as CO_CD, and editor dropdowns now use compact styled listboxes with keyboard navigation.
Dataset labels preserve the exact case and punctuation configured in the Project Settings Dataset Types table.
The When and Then chips no longer repeat secondary scope and action captions.
Condition-value suggestion menus stay within the viewport and remain visible over the editor summary and action bar.
The View JSON, Validate all, and Add rule toolbar actions use the compact Project Settings button type scale.
Leaving the rule name blank saves an auto-generated name built from the rule content.
